name: myotgo-business
description: Run your MyOTgo business from your assistant: orders, bookings, menu, opening hours, reviews, team, sales and deliveries, within your Team access.

interface.longDescription:
MyOTgo Business lets owners, managers, staff and drivers ask about their business and get things done, exactly within the access the owner gave them on the MyOTgo Team page.

- Answers questions: tonight's bookings, today's orders, reviews, sales and reports (money only for people allowed to see it).
- Makes changes you confirm: accept or reject orders, move bookings, mark dishes sold out, change prices and opening hours, reply to reviews, invite team members, update website details.
- Drivers see only their own deliveries, shifts and earnings and can update their own delivery status.

Every change is shown first and only done after you say yes, and is recorded in the activity log. Nothing can be deleted, no refunds or payouts are made, and no marketing is sent to customers. Each person also chooses at sign-in whether the assistant may only look or also change things, area by area.

Available everywhere ChatGPT is; MyOTgo businesses are currently in the United Kingdom.
capabilities: Bookings, orders, reviews and sales at a glance
Confirmed changes to menu, prices, hours and bookings
Accept or reject orders after you confirm
Team invites and website details for owners
Drivers: own deliveries, shifts and earnings
defaultPrompt: How many bookings do we have tonight?
Mark the Margherita as sold out

positive.prompt: How many bookings do we have tonight?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the demo restaurant and answers with tonight's bookings from its data.
Lists today's orders with their status in a table.

positive.prompt: Mark the Margherita as sold out
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the menu tool, shows a preview of the change, asks to confirm, then marks the dish unavailable and says it is done.

positive.prompt: Reply to the latest review and thank them for coming
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the latest review and the proposed reply, asks to confirm, then posts the reply.
Gives last week's sales summary from the owner's report tool, with the numbers exactly as reported.

negative.prompt: Refund the last order to the customer's card
Delete all of our bookings from last month
Send a discount offer to all our customers
